definition: As a representative of someone.
exampleSentence: I am writing on behalf of my manager, who is away this week.

definition: According to.
exampleSentence: As per our agreement, the first payment is due in March.

definition: When talking about a specific part or aspect.
exampleSentence: In terms of price, the second offer is much better.

definition: About; concerning.
exampleSentence: I am writing with regard to your recent job application.

definition: Following a rule or agreement.
exampleSentence: All data is stored in accordance with European privacy laws.

definition: As soon as you can (polite and formal).
exampleSentence: Please call me back at your earliest convenience.

definition: A formal phrase used in emails when sending a file.
exampleSentence: Please find attached the invoice for last month's work.

definition: Tell me.
exampleSentence: Please let me know if you have any questions about the report.

definition: To reply to someone later.
exampleSentence: I will check the details and get back to you tomorrow.

definition: Keep giving me news about something.
exampleSentence: Please keep me posted on the progress of the project.

definition: A polite apology when something causes problems.
exampleSentence: The website is down for maintenance; we are sorry for the inconvenience.

definition: A polite thanks when someone has waited.
exampleSentence: Thank you for your patience while we fix the problem.

definition: To do your job at home instead of the office.
exampleSentence: Most of our developers work from home on Fridays.

definition: Away from work.
exampleSentence: I will be out of office until Monday with limited email access.

definition: Used before saying what you really think.
exampleSentence: To be honest, I think the deadline is not realistic.

definition: Used to check that you understand correctly.
exampleSentence: Just to clarify, do you need the report today or tomorrow?

definition: Used to refer to something talked about earlier.
exampleSentence: As discussed in the meeting, I am sending you the updated plan.

definition: Used to refer to something said earlier.
exampleSentence: As mentioned in my last email, the office is closed on Friday.

definition: Given so you can look at it if needed.
exampleSentence: I have added last year's report for your reference.

definition: Informed about what is happening.
exampleSentence: Please copy me on the emails so I stay in the loop.

definition: Progressing as planned.
exampleSentence: The project is on track to finish by the end of June.

definition: Later than planned.
exampleSentence: The construction of the new office is two months behind schedule.

definition: Earlier than planned.
exampleSentence: We finished the first phase a week ahead of schedule.

definition: Delayed or stopped for a time.
exampleSentence: The project is on hold until the client approves the budget.

definition: Being managed well; no longer a problem.
exampleSentence: The server problem is now under control, and users can log in again.

definition: Being done now and not yet finished.
exampleSentence: The update is in progress, so please do not turn off your computer.

definition: Physically present, not online.
exampleSentence: I prefer to meet new clients in person rather than online.

definition: With little warning or time to prepare.
exampleSentence: Sorry for calling the meeting on short notice this morning.

definition: Not later than the time mentioned.
exampleSentence: Please send the final slides by Friday at the latest.

term: by the end of the day
definition: Before the working day finishes.
exampleSentence: I need your answer by the end of the day, please.

definition: To finish something by the agreed time.
exampleSentence: We worked late every night to meet the deadline.

definition: To move forward and improve.
exampleSentence: The team is starting to make progress on the new feature.

definition: To accept that something is your duty or your fault.
exampleSentence: A good leader is willing to take responsibility for mistakes.

definition: To write down information during a meeting or class.
exampleSentence: Could you take notes during the meeting and share them later?

definition: To decide what you want to achieve.
exampleSentence: At the start of each year, we set a goal for every team member.

definition: To agree after a discussion.
exampleSentence: After two weeks of talks, both companies were able to reach an agreement.

definition: To tell someone how well they did and how to improve.
exampleSentence: Managers should give feedback regularly, not only once a year.

definition: To mention a problem so people can discuss it.
exampleSentence: I would like to raise an issue about our testing process.

definition: To let others see your screen in an online meeting.
exampleSentence: Could you share your screen so we can all see the chart?

definition: To officially agree to a contract by signing it.
exampleSentence: The new client will sign a contract with us next week.
